June, I couldn't set this up. The scheduler I'd use for the recurring note isn't working: it fails with a gateway credentials error. Nothing is scheduled, so no 'Pod end of day' note will go out at 17:30 today or on any later weekday.

The error says the gateway needs an auth token or password configured, or the device needs pairing. I can't fix that from here, so someone who administers the gateway will need to. Once that's done, tell me and I'll create the job. It would run weekdays at 17:30 Central, starting today, and post the day's new #strategic-pod messages as 'Pod end of day'.

If you'd rather not wait for that, ask me for the note by hand. I can post one in here whenever you like, including at 17:30 today.
